items.html: Also there is another aspect: when you take the three fillings alone that were mentioned, which are YH'A, they are in gematria sixteen. And when you form the letter Hei in its two forms, which are Dalet-Vav and Dalet-Yud, they are in gematria twenty-four. And with the sixteen of the filling, there are forty, likewise like the count of milk. Behold, it has been explained that there are two kinds of milk in the letter Hei of Elokim, which are the milk drawn to the right breast and the milk drawn into the left breast.
